turns.message: Make a 20 mm cube in SolidCraft.
turns.result_text:
I'll start by looking at what's in the working directory to see how SolidCraft is set up here.


<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">ls -la; git log --oneline | head -5</parameter>
</invoke>

<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">which solidcraft solidcraft-mcp 2>/dev/null; ls ../.. 2>/dev/null | head -50</parameter>
</invoke>

<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">grep -ril solidcraft --include=*.md --include=*.json --include=*.toml . ../.. 2>/dev/null | head -20</parameter>
</invoke>

<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">ls -a ../../.. ; ls -a ../../../.. | head -50</parameter>
</invoke>

<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">cat ../../../README.md 2>/dev/null | head -80</parameter>
</invoke>
